item.title: [html, ecmascript] Conflicting definitions of ImageData constructor
item.content:encoded:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/ImageData/ImageData#syntax

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Syntax

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

There are conflicting informations on the constructor of ImageData:

  • WhatWG implies that Float16Array is a valid as data in the interface - thus the constructor should certainly allow that
  • The IDL of a recent Chromium also allows this. It's available since 137
  • MDN only list Uint8ClampedArray as being a valid data type.

Note: There also is the Overview page which also only mentions data being types as Uint8ClampedArray

What did you expect to see?

MDN being in sync with the WhatWG spec.

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

No response

Do you have anything more you want to share?

There have been some PRs in this area in the past, most notably #39023 which adds Float16Array, but the constructor wasn't changed, might be by mistake.

item.title: [ecmascript] Yielding rejected promises from a sync generator now properly closes the iterator
